Subject: Hestor Mercantile Submission - Referral Questions

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the Hestor Mercantile submission. I've reviewed the information and have a few questions before we can move forward.

The account shows five-year incurred losses exceeding $250K, which requires additional review. To help evaluate this risk, could you please provide:

- Details on the loss history (causes, corrective actions taken)
- Current risk management practices in place
- Any recent property improvements or updates

Once I have these answers, I'll escalate to our senior underwriting team for consideration.

Alternatively, given the loss history, you might consider reaching out to a surplus lines market that specializes in higher-hazard risks—they may be better positioned to provide competitive terms.

Let me know if you have questions!

Best,
[Underwriter name]
